name: Denta
long_description:
Denta saves you money on dental insurance.

When you go to buy dental insurance, instead of picking the plan where 25% of your money goes to Brokers, CEOs, and Administrators, you pick the plan where 100% of your money goes to the dentist.

I started Denta by building software for my dad's 10 dental practices in Iowa. In scaling that product to 13k MRR in 10 weeks, I realized I was working on a small problem in dentistry. Existing software sucks, no doubt, but what dentists complain about even more: insurance.

Insurance is a massive burden on the industry. Dental Software companies make $6B/year. Dental Insurance Companies make $100B/year. 25% of that is wasted on administrators, brokers, and c-suite salaries. As the son of a dentist, I will not let these companies continue to burn $25B/year. That money should go to dentists via reimbursements, patients via more coverage, and employers via reduced costs.
